newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel to decide on Powerfin merger.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel to decide on Powerfin merger.

text.p: The board of directors of Tractebel SA is set to decide on Thursday whether or not the Belgian utility holding company will merge with its Powerfin unit, Tractebel said on Monday.
"The issue will be on the agenda on Thursday," a Tractebel spokesman told Reuters. "From an operational point of view, a merger with Powerfin would be a good thing."
Powerfin spearheads Tractebel's foreign expansion drive.
He declined to comment on a report in Belgian financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd which said the terms of exchange could be one Tractebel share for three Powerfin shares.

Powerfin -- 59.77 percent owned by Tractebel -- operates power plants in Northern Ireland, Portugal, the U.S., Germany, Hungary and Chile and has projects in many other countries, including Oman, Italy, India, Kazakhstan and Malaysia.

Tractebel parent company Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique SA (SGB) i s expected to welcome a Tractebel-Powerfin merger, analysts have said, as this would allow SGB to reduce its Tractebel stake to just over 50 percent from the current 65 percent.
